note: Owner decision D1 (2026-10-25): an item the sim DB records no source for enters a pre-raid pool only with a source-cited entry in this file; battleground reputation-vendor/battlefield items are PvP (src pvp-rep/pvp-rank) and carry their side for faction legality. Semantics: pre_raid=true admits (and is the allowlist for unrecorded epics); pre_raid=false excludes; pre_raid=null means the public page records no source at all - only blues/greens then fall through to the ilvl-65 rule, epics never. Method: wowhead.com/forever item pages (Quick Facts, Related/Reward-from/Sold-by/Created-by/Dropped-by tables, quest and NPC pages) 2026-10-25; classic_ilvl from the wowhead.com/classic tooltip service for the cross-era comparison (Forever rescales: Onyxia Tooth Pendant 74 -> 65). Scope: every item worn by an r11 shipped set that has no recorded source and still exists in the 52fb82e1fe DB; step 5 extends it to r12 winners. The 23 worn 21994-22112 "Heroism/Darkmantle/Sorcerer's/..." pieces are excluded because upstream removed them at 52fb82e1fe.
